title: EF01-P: optional Direct Git, pytest-xdist 12 workers and MT-01 Minimum Test
owner: EF01 verification; EF02 host capacity integration
objective: Nâng cấp đường Git/pytest có cấu hình, thêm Minimum Test chọn/reuse/invalidated evidence theo AC và changed dependencies, tích hợp EF01-R/EF02 mà không full-suite lặp vô lý hoặc tạo kết quả PASS giả.

design.current_baseline: subprocess argv uses git directly via PATH; pytest profiles serial; no pytest-xdist declared
design.direct_git: Optional explicit git executable path/GIT executable resolution; no implicit shell/wrapper/hardcoded C:\ path; fallback git on PATH
design.pytest_parallel: Human-selected EF01 pytest default 12 xdist workers for the first/primary active action on each Windows host, including local EF01 and EF02→EF01; following concurrent actions receive 2 workers each. Not an adaptive 4/8/12 benchmark choice. Serial is a truthful exceptional fallback only.
design.host_budget: Host-wide single 12-worker primary lease across all EF02 batches/processes; other active actions use 2 workers each. Concurrency N: desired total 12+2*(N-1) pytest workers (N=1:12, N=2:14, N=3:16); EF02 max_parallel default remains 2, not raised by this policy. Deterministic first-active-action order and cross-process atomic lease; safe handoff at next verification boundary when primary finishes, never restart in-progress pytest solely to promote.
design.measurement: Human reports earlier Windows head-to-head 2/4/8/12/16 xdist runs selected 12 as fastest. HUMAN_REPORTED_PRIOR_BENCHMARK; no independent numeric data attached and no repeat benchmark required. Collect per-run worker count, exit/status and host health, not mandatory performance trials.
design.fallback: Only minimal xdist availability/process-start/serious-host-resource/fixture-race checks; do not silently downgrade primary from 12 to 4 or 8 because other actions are active. When actual xdist or host prevents safely starting 12, record explicit degraded/serial fallback or stop, without claiming 12-worker conformance. Secondary defaults 2 when supported.

minimum_test.owner: EF01-P; EF02 consumes per-action verification and fan-in evidence
minimum_test.selection: Deterministic smallest sufficient registered pytest set from changed paths, AC, direct/indirect consumers and contract dependencies; never empty only to obtain PASS.
reuse_binding: base and candidate relevant-file hashes or tree/commit
pytest argv/test definitions and runner environment
prior execution exit and immutable artifact refs
minimum_test.invalidation: Changed code, tests, imports/contracts, dependencies, environment or dependency fan-in that could alter claimed covered behavior invalidates corresponding cached PASS. Hash/source mismatch is not eligible for reuse.
minimum_test.ef01_repair: Run failed and affected regression pytest after repair; reuse only evidence remaining valid; retain original selected executor/model/effort and repair budget.
minimum_test.ef02_integration: Action-scoped approved verification plans, preserve claims/fingerprints; at fan-in verify merged candidate's affected consumers, not just sibling PASS results.
minimum_test.safe_fallback: Unknown coverage => broader targeted/full registered profile or UNPROVEN, never fabricated PASS. pytest no-tests/internal/timeout are not success.
minimum_test.registered_profile_constraint: Current EF02 only accepts registered pytest argv; future dynamic selection must remain deterministic/validated, no arbitrary command injection.
minimum_test.xdist_relation: 12 workers default for primary action and 2 for later simultaneous actions on same Windows host, one host-global 12 seat; not 12 model executors. Scope selection and worker concurrency are independent; preserve EF02 max_parallel default=2.

acceptance: Explicit Git path produces correct argv for all current Git calls on Windows; missing/bad path fails clearly or configured safe fallback without changing source provenance.

Human-selected default 12 xdist pytest workers for primary EF01 Windows action; subsequent simultaneous actions run 2, including across EF02 batches; serial fallback is observable, 12 is not claimed when not actually run.
Record Human-reported prior comparison where 12 was fastest among 2/4/8/12/16; no redundant benchmark gate. Verify actual workers, host errors and CI/runner evidence for the new implementation.
Host-wide atomic allocation enforces 12+2 for two concurrent actions and 12+2+2 for three when allowed, without two 12-worker primaries, across batches; transfer priority at safe verify boundary.
MT-01 chooses minimum sufficient tests grounded by changed files, dependency consumers and AC; audit record explains EXECUTE/REUSE/INVALIDATED/UNPROVEN.
PASS evidence reuse is permitted only when code/test/dependency/environment fingerprint and AC coverage remain valid; edits affecting prior evidence require rerun.
EF01-R repair reruns failed/affected tests and preserves valid PASS without duplicate action/provider side effects; failure and unknown are not promoted to PASS.
EF02 fan-in invalidates affected sibling evidence and runs aggregate consumer/integration coverage, otherwise returns UNPROVEN instead of claimed batch PASS.
Race/crash/stale host-wide primary lease cannot cause duplicate 12-worker groups; report allocation/degrade reason and do not interrupt an ongoing 2-worker pytest to promote.
non_goals: Impose 12 workers on every CI job
Mandatory full-suite after every repair; a new lifecycle/gate; importing AIOS-Renew verification runtime
